newsitem.title: USA: America West says court dismisses claims.
newsitem.headline: America West says court dismisses claims.

text.p: America West Airlines said Friday a federal district judge had dismissed claims of the International Brotherhood of Teamsters and four individual plaintiffs in a lawsuit related to the airline's decision to outsource its heavy maintenance operations.

In the lawsuit, originally filed in December 1995, the plaintiffs sought a determination that America West's decision to outsource maintenance had violated federal labor laws and requested certification of the lawsuit as a class action.

The company said the individual and class suits were dismissed because each had entered into a severance arrangement with America West. He also ruled that the Teamsters was not the collective bargaining representative of the airline's employees, the company said.
